data.subject: Public-record microcap research
data.body:
Hi,

Orchard Capital's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in FIP, NODK, and IDR.

FIP entered into a material definitive agreement in an 8-K Item 1.01 filed September 28, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1899883/000114036126037763/ef20082849_8k.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
